---
title: "Analyzing US Census Data"
author: "Oluchi Nnadi"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```


```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by County in Texas",
    subtitle = "2016-2020 American Community Survey",
    fill = "Median Income"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    "B15003_022",
    "B15003_023",
    "B15003_024",
    "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 10
edu_state |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    pct_bachelors_or_higher = sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / first(summary_est),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_bachelors_or_higher, y = reorder(NAME, pct_bachelors_or_higher))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Educational Attainment: Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    subtitle = "Percentage of population aged 25 and older",
    x = "Percent of Population (Age 25+)",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: 2016-2020 American Community Survey, US Census Bureau"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(face = "italic", color = "gray30")
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca |>
  select(-moe) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = variable,
    values_from = estimate
  ) |>
  mutate(short_name = str_remove(NAME, " County, California")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = median_age, y = population)) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(population >= 1000000, short_name, "")),
    vjust = -0.7,
    hjust = 0.5,
    size = 3.2,
    check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "California Counties: Population vs. Median Age",
    subtitle = "Largest counties (population \u2265 1M) labeled",
    x = "Median Age (Years)",
    y = "Total Population (Log Scale)",
    caption = "Source: 2016-2020 American Community Survey, US Census Bureau"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title.position = "plot",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(face = "italic", color = "gray30")
  )
```
